notes.title: Shut your teeth FINAL UPDATE 2022: the whole novel has been re-edited
notes.content:
This is the final version of "Shut your teeth" that successfully deals with all the pacing issues. The novel is now shorter and better! If you tried it before but found the pacing too slow, I encourage you to try again!

All the old saves should be working as usual. To access the new version, you have to start a new game.
